name: Tully's Coffee Shapo Loco Hirai
nameJa: タリーズコーヒー シャポーロコ平井店
address: 3-30-1 Hirai, Shapo Loco Hirai 1F/2F, Edogawa-ku, Tokyo
description: A roomy two-floor Tully's built directly into the Shapo Loco mall at Hirai Station, noted for free Wi-Fi and USB/outlet-equipped seating that makes it comfortable for laptop work.

name: Doutor Coffee Koiwa South Exit
nameJa: ドトールコーヒーショップ 小岩駅南口店
description: A 53-seat, fully non-smoking Doutor just off the south exit of JR Koiwa that lists both free Wi-Fi and power outlets in its official amenities, a practical short-work stop.

name: Doutor Coffee Shapo Koiwa
nameJa: ドトールコーヒーショップ シャポー小岩店
description: Located inside the Shapo Koiwa station complex, this Doutor is documented as having power outlets plus carrier (SoftBank) Wi-Fi, so bring your own connection for extended sessions.

name: Komeda Coffee Kasai South Exit
nameJa: コメダ珈琲店 葛西南口店
description: A spacious 71-seat Komeda about five minutes from Kasai Station with its own Komeda Wi-Fi and outlet-equipped seating, with long hours and roomy booths suited to sustained work.

name: Kohikan Ario Kasai
nameJa: 珈琲館 アリオ葛西店
description: A relaxed Kohikan on the second floor of the Ario Kasai shopping mall that provides free Wi-Fi but no documented power outlets, best for shorter battery-only stints.

name: Doutor Coffee Nishi-Kasai South Exit
nameJa: ドトールコーヒーショップ 西葛西南口店
description: A convenient Doutor by the south exit of Nishi-Kasai Station listed only with carrier (docomo/au) Wi-Fi and no power outlets, fine for a quick coffee-and-email break.

name: Doutor Coffee Mizue
nameJa: ドトールコーヒーショップ 瑞江店
description: The main documented cafe option near quiet Mizue Station, this Doutor is listed with carrier (docomo/au) Wi-Fi only and no power outlets, so it suits brief visits.
